dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "26: Please do not carry any valuables with you when flying to avoid dropping them."

dialogues.speaker: Flight Regulations
dialogues.text: "If a similar situation occurs, please ask any flying squad for assistance."

dialogues.speaker: Chief's Message
dialogues.text: "Due to the variance in difficulty involved in finding different items, our flying squads cannot guarantee definite retrieval of any lost belongings. Please pay close attention and follow all regulations."
